title: melothria kelungensis
intro: Melothria kelungensis, commonly known as Taiwanese gac, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cucurbitaceae. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The therapeutic actions of Melothria kelungensis include its ability to support immune function, improve cardiovascular health, and exert potential anticancer effects. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
